product_launches.description: PlaysOut plans to launch 15 Dogecoin-themed mini games throughout 2025, with the first game scheduled for August. These games will be playable via the MyDoge wallet and PlaysOut mobile app, integrating DOGE into blockchain-based gaming.

product_launches.description: PlaysOut launched its on-chain mini-game platform and SDK toolkit, fully integrated with WeChat's mini-game publishing framework.

overview_description.description: PlaysOut is a gaming infrastructure company that develops tools and platforms for embedding mini-games into mobile apps, messaging platforms, and super apps. The company provides a software development kit (SDK) and runtime system that allows developers and platform operators to distribute lightweight games across multiple environments without requiring separate app downloads. Its platform supports cross-platform game deployment, analytics, monetization, and optional Web3 features such as token-based rewards and digital asset integration. PlaysOut works with game developers, app platforms, and entertainment companies to support user engagement through embedded interactive content.
